description: This Java class 'ReadableOrder' represents an order entity with associated customer, products, currency, billing and delivery addresses, and summary totals such as total, tax, and shipping. It extends 'OrderEntity' and implements 'Serializable'.

classes.name: ReadableOrder
classes.description: Represents a readable version of an order with customer details, products, addresses, and totals, capable of serialization.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the customer associated with the order.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the customer associated with the order.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount of the order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total amount of the order.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Returns the tax total for the order.

methods.name: setTax
methods.description: Sets the tax total for the order.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Returns the shipping total for the order.

methods.name: setShipping
methods.description: Sets the shipping total for the order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of products in the order.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of products in the order.

methods.name: getCurrencyModel
methods.description: Returns the currency model associated with the order.

methods.name: setCurrencyModel
methods.description: Sets the currency model for the order.
